checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Three separate square images, no collage.

must.item: Fox matches mascot face, markings, proportions
must.why: Same face, ear tips, cheek markings, white-tipped tail. The bike fox's head is slightly narrower and the body proportions shift a little.
Orange hoodie with blue jeans and black gloves/boots in all three.

must.item: Bike in park / baking cookies in kitchen / reading under tree
must.why: All three scenes are clearly shown. The fox holds a tray of baked cookies at the oven, which reads as baking.
Bold outlines and flat colors, no text. The kitchen has slightly more texture and detail than the reference.

faults.what: Kitchen scene is busier and slightly more textured than the flat reference.
Bike picture: the fox's pose is a bit stiff and its legs overlap the bike awkwardly. The hoodie lacks the front pocket.
Cookies are already baked on a tray, so the fox is holding them rather than mid-bake.

summary: Three consistent square flat-cartoon fox scenes (bike, cookies, reading) with the orange hoodie and no text; only minor style and pose quibbles.
